scripts.build:all: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=client vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=admin vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && firebase deploy --only hosting --project cater-booking
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build:client && firebase deploy --only hosting:client --project cater-booking
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin --project cater-booking
